subject: Private VPC: Staging Deployment Handbook & Diagram Pack
messages:
From: Mike Hart <mike.hart@acme.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: Cloudix Partner <partner@cloudix.io>
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private VPC: Staging deployment — request for reference package

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week. The infra team at Acme Health is ready to schedule a staging deployment with Cloudix as our network integrator. Before we lock in dates, the network and SRE leads asked for a concise reference pack they can hand to ops:

- Control-plane/data-plane separation diagram for the on-prem VPC attachment
- Expected egress and NAT patterns (preferred and fallback)
- A staging "ops checklist" (step-by-step, preflight, rollback steps)
- Any recommended canary window timing and load targets (tokens/sec and concurrent connections)

Can you share a single bundle we can review? If Cloudix has any suggested changes to the networking paths, please include as well.

Target: staging week of May 11, but we can shift based on your checklist.

Thanks,
Mike
Mike Hart
Director, Cloud Engineering — Acme Health

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Mike Hart <mike.hart@acme.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Jon as Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Cloudix Partner <partner@cloudix.io>
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private VPC: Staging deployment — request for reference package

Mike —

Appreciate the clear list. Looping in Kim (network lead) and Aditya (deploy/runbooks). We'll assemble a compact package and include a recommended canary window.

Immediate plan:
- Kim will draft a control-plane / data-plane reference PDF (single-page and expanded view).
- Aditya will produce a one-sheet ops-checklist (preflight, cutover, rollback).
- Jonas will add the recommended canary/load targets based on our current Dedicated profiles.

We should be able to share a first draft by Thu, Apr 23. If that timeline works, can we tentatively schedule staging for the week of May 11 and lock in a two-day blackout for the canary (low-traffic daytime window)?

Action item: Mike, please confirm any hard egress constraints (e.g., mandatory commercial firewall IP ranges) so Kim can annotate the diagrams.

Cheers,
Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Mike Hart <mike.hart@acme.com>, Cloudix Partner <partner@cloudix.io>
Date: Thu, 23 Apr 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Private VPC: Staging deployment — request for reference package

Stephanie / team / Mike —

Attached are the artifacts for the Acme staging handoff: 
- vpc-staging-diagrams-v1.pdf (contains: single-page summary, control-plane/data-plane annotated flows, NAT/egress options, peering and tunnel fallbacks)
- ops-checklist-staging.xlsx (preflight checks, cutover steps, validation tests, rollback steps)

Key callouts in the diagrams:
- Control plane (management/control API) nodes are in a separate subnet behind the management firewall; all control traffic is restricted to mutual TLS and a limited set of source IPs (see green box on page 1).
- Data plane exposes inference endpoints behind an internal LB. We recommend one dedicated subnet per tenant group in staging to validate routing policies.
- Egress model: primary egress via a dedicated NAT gateway in the customer DMZ; fallback path uses Cloudix-managed egress relay with policy enforcement (page 3).
- BFD/HA recommendations are noted for the IPSec tunnels; pcap capture points suggested for initial validation.

Canary guidance (Jonas):
- Day 1 (canary): 1,200 tokens/sec sustained peak; 20 concurrent streams; 5% sample traffic for fidelity checks.
- Day 2 (ramp): 5,000 tokens/sec peak; 50 concurrent streams; gradually remove sampling.
- If 99.9th latency exceeds target SLO by 50% for 15m, trigger rollback.

Attachments: [vpc-staging-diagrams-v1.pdf (application/pdf), ops-checklist-staging.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

Next steps: Mike — if you confirm the egress firewall ranges and accept the canary window we can schedule the staging cutover calendar invite.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Network Engineer — Redwood Inference

From: Mike Hart <mike.hart@acme.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: Cloudix Partner <partner@cloudix.io>
Date: Fri, 24 Apr 2026 10:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private VPC: Staging deployment — request for reference package

Thanks Kim — this is great and very thorough. Two quick clarifications before we move the calendar: 

1) Egress firewall: we can open the following ranges for the window: 198.51.100.0/24 and 203.0.113.128/27. Please annotate page 3 where you reference "customer DMZ" and include the specific rules we need to push to perimeter.

2) Canary window: May 12 (Wed) 10:00–16:00 PT looks good for the day 1 window. Can we ask Cloudix to run the BFD/HA checks in the hour prior (09:00–10:00)?

Also, small request — can you provide the diagrams as a lightweight PNG single-page summary we can paste into our runbook? The PDF is perfect for deep review but the ops team prefers an image for quick reference.

If all good, I'll approve and send a calendar invite and CC SRE for the post-cutover validation.

-Mike
